Title: LSJ - Horde special ability in torpor

Messages.Author: xcver
Messages.Body:
Hi,

we were wondering if the Horde can use it's special even when in
torpor. The rulebook states that a vampire in torpor can take no
actions other than the leave torpor actions, cannot block or play
reactions cards. It also says that it can play action modifiers during
his actions. But what about this ability?

The Horde may tap to give another infernal minion +1 bleed for the
current action.

I was under the assumption they can, as per this ruling here:

http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/browse_thread/thread/ad4c8d0ec50f0e72/51a634793c7b83ab?lnk=gst&q=tap+ability+in+torpor+author%3ALSJ#51a634793c7b83ab

Thanks,

Bernd
